answer_2.quote: Evaluation Metrics. Our evaluation metrics consist of general metrics applied across all tasks and datasets: (1) Average Reward, (2) Diversity, and (3) Coherence. Additionally, we employ datasetspecific metrics: Attack Success Rate (ASR) for AdvBench to evaluate whether language models produce targeted outputs, ROUGE-L for measuring summary quality in the summarization task, and Accuracy for assessing solution correctness in GSM8K.
